title: ••Reserve Pilot
caption: ••Reserve Pilot (V)
lore: Injuries kept Lord Vader's best TIE wingman out of the primary wave of starfighters. He remains on reserve duty, ready to replace lost pilots.
game_text: {pilot:2}. While piloting at a system, your total battle destiny here is cumulatively +1. If a battle at a system just ended, may deploy (for free) aboard a starship from which you forfeited a pilot character.
